channel.title: Research Tape
channel.description: A daily AI-in-finance research tape: arXiv and SSRN, six items or fewer.

item.title: Short Windows, Unmodelled Costs, Unknown Cutoffs: A Pre-Registered Evidence Audit of 91 LLM Trading Papers
item.description: Ninety-eight percent of LLM trading papers fail leakage controls because they do not test after training cutoffs.

item.title: Automating Asset Pricing Research: An Agentic Search for the SDF
item.description: An agentic system finds a stochastic discount factor with a 3.38 out-of-sample Sharpe ratio.

item.title: Drift-Resilient Explainable Graph Learning for Financial Fraud Detection: Joint Evaluation of Risk Calibration and Explanation Stability
item.description: A diagnose-then-act policy matches full retraining performance with 91 percent fewer retraining events.

item.title: Candidate Execution-Time Windows and Intraday Market Microstructure: Evidence from High-frequency Volume, Machine Learning, and Trading Tests
item.description: Prespecified execution windows are associated with statistically significant abnormal intraday trading volume.

item.title: Accounting-grounded Explainable Machine Learning for Financial Statement Misstatement Detection: Temporal Validation Using U.S. Public-Company Filings
item.description: Leaky evaluation protocols inflate misstatement detection AUC by up to 0.107 and reverse model rankings.

item.title: Decomposable Reward Modeling and Realistic Environment Design for Reinforcement Learning-based Forex Trading
item.description: Additional reward penalties do not consistently improve reinforcement learning trading performance.

item.title: Contextualizing Corporate Governance with AI Proxy Advice: Evidence from Proxy Contests
item.description: Contextual AI proxy advice outperforms traditional advisor returns by six to seven percentage points in proxy contests.

item.title: Measuring Market Rationality: The Boundaries of an Information Ecology Health Index A Three-Layer Test of Explanation, Prediction, and Early Warning
item.description: The Information Ecology Health Index explains but does not predict or warn about extreme volatility.

item.title: Conformal Risk Certificates for Portfolio Optimization Under Uncertainty: A Gated Reinforcement-Learning Approach
item.description: Gated conformal risk control removes all out-of-sample semantic limit breaches at a 100-basis-point return cost.

item.title: BuySideFlow: A Point-in-Time Benchmark for LLM Agents in Investment Research
item.description: LLM agents pass result checks while violating point-in-time validity in half of audited runs.

item.title: Point-in-Time Encoders for Earnings Calls
item.description: PIT encoders beat general retrievers on earnings calls yet fail to forecast returns better.

item.title: How Much Sustainability is Really in Stock Prices?
item.description: No sustainability model survives multiple-testing corrections across 132 specifications.

item.title: Optimal Trading Speed on Blockchain
item.description: Faster blockchain blocks widen effective spreads even as arbitrage profits rise.

item.title: Fine-Tuning an Order-Flow Foundation Model for Sub-Second Forecasting
item.description: A fine-tuned generative order-flow model beats gradient boosting on sub-second microprice returns.

item.title: Same Business, Different Books: Language Models Reveal Where Financial Reporting Comparability Breaks Down
item.description: ASC 842 failed to move lease-intensive balance sheets closer to economic peers.

item.title: Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations
item.description: Zero-shot foundation models produce no incremental forecasting skill over no-change for intraday equity index futures.

item.title: Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents
item.description: LLM-analyst paper trading returned 34.5 percent versus 14.4 percent for SPY over the same period.

item.title: This Machine Picks Stocks
item.description: Decoupling prediction from expected-value trade selection produced positive short-term equity returns in out-of-sample backtests.

item.title: Headline AI Numbers Hide Disagreement: Grader Refusal, Contested Labels and Lost Verdicts in AI Safety and Financial Evaluation
item.description: Headline AI safety scores mask grader disagreement, with attack success estimates ranging from 9.8 to 49.0 percent.

item.title: Retrospective Analysis of Team-Following Trading Profitability in Pumpfun Meme Coins Using Funding Networks
item.description: Known-token-team following generated retrospective returns above one SOL in eight Pumpfun windows, conditional on hindsight selection.

item.title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
item.description: FinCut Boundary dates vary across models, and some models show clear relative declines in U.S. financial recall after the boundary.

item.title: Direction Instability in an LLM Evidence Synthesizer: A Pre-Registered Two-Wave Study of Recorded Trading Inputs
item.description: At research weight 1.0, a temperature-zero hosted LLM flips consensus on about one-third of evenly divided evidence sets.

item.title: Does a Trading Policy Need to Know What It Trades? Microstructure Invariance and Zero-Shot Transfer of Execution Policies
item.description: Microstructure-invariant execution inputs beat raw features by under one basis point and fail to extrapolate to unseen spread regimes.

item.title: Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market
item.description: LLM news judgments correlate with post-announcement returns but the association vanishes from the first trade after publication.

item.title: DeepFinance: Can AI Diligence a $100MM Deal?
item.description: The top model satisfies only 57.6 percent of diligence rubric criteria and often acts on the wrong inputs.

item.title: Code-Paper Consistency in Economics and Finance
item.description: Nearly half of sampled finance papers contain at least one potentially serious code-paper discrepancy in a central result.

item.title: Counsel ex Machina: The Value and Limits of AI Financial Advice
item.description: Users place substantial weight on chatbot financial advice but suffer more behavioral bias under misleading framing.

item.title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
item.description: No agent passed FINCOSMOS even when the simulated user signed off on its strategy.

item.title: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
item.description: Most LLM-generated trading hypotheses fail pre-registered gates despite strong discovery and validation metrics.

item.title: The Financial Impact of Non-Financial Beliefs in Large Language Models
item.description: LLM-driven analyst optimism about high-ESG firms lifts target prices but degrades earnings forecast accuracy.

item.title: The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
item.description: Alignment tax under length-normalized DPO with SFT retention is task-selective, degrading router performance but sparing extraction.

item.title: The Illusion of Informed Congressional Trading: Evidence from Committee Networks and Hearings
item.description: Congressional trades aligned with committee assignments produce no abnormal returns before or after hearings.

item.title: One Basket, Many Experts: Decorrelated Re-ranking for Financial Asset Recommendation
item.description: Replacing a few recommendation slots with decorrelated assets improves risk-adjusted return at small relevance cost after trading costs.

item.title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market
item.description: Commercial LLM news signals predict overnight moves but not post-open returns.

item.title: Beyond Anonymous Order Flow: Wallet Identity as a Feature for Short-Horizon Return Prediction
item.description: Wallet identity features raise one-second out-of-sample R2 from 10.88% to above 12%.

item.title: Right Model, Wrong Answer: How Missing User Context Silently Flips AI Financial Advice
item.description: Omitting one user fact makes frontier AI financial advice confidently wrong 33 of 33 times.

item.title: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation
item.description: Fine-tuned small decision models show no edge beyond prior base rates on reality-labeled finance questions.

item.title: LENS: Reliability-Aware Stock Prediction via LLM-Extracted Priors and News-Driven Semantic Graphs
item.description: Reliability-weighted LLM graphs and news semantics lift S&P 500 top-five ranking 16-23%.

item.title: LLM-Generated Investment Research Memos Need Validation
item.description: One-to-two percent claim refutation still leaves 37-41% of LLM memos containing a false claim.

item.title: The flow, not the headline: point-in-time LLM sentiment and the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns *
item.description: Point-in-time LLM sentiment predicts next-day crypto returns at 21 bps daily with 2.21 Sharpe, serving as a veto not a tilt.

item.title: Monetary Policy Expectations of Sophisticated Investors
item.description: Hedge fund monetary policy expectations predict yield curve moves, and funds with more accurate forecasts earn higher risk-adjusted returns.

item.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
item.description: Pretraining-era benchmark scores exceed post-cutoff scores, but tighter retrieval controls narrow the gap between backtests and live results.

item.title: The Cryptocurrency Trend Factor Revisited: Predictive Information, Portfolio Construction, and Pricing Claims
item.description: Comprehensive correction of the crypto trend factor eliminates its alpha and turns factor-substitution gains into significant declines.

item.title: TrackMem: Tracking Evolving Beliefs in Long-Horizon Financial Dialogue
item.description: A per-speaker graph memory beats existing systems on revised-figure questions, reaching 73.9% accuracy versus 69.4% for the strongest baseline.

item.title: Herding or Racing? Decomposing Cross-Account Order-Flow Persistence in On-Chain Markets
item.description: Most cross-account order-flow persistence on Uniswap is CEX price arbitration rather than herding, and this race flow drives most liquidity-provider losses.

item.title: AStockArena: Beyond Returns, Can We Entrust Real Capital to the Decisions of Financial Agents?
item.description: Seventy-three percent of audited trading decisions contain at least one audit gap, and portfolio outcomes shift when flagged trades are removed.

item.title: Do Earnings Calls Help Predict Financial Restatements? Evaluating Text Beyond Public Firm Information
item.description: Earnings-call text flags restatements but adds no ranking gain over public firm information, while LLMs leak tickers and use future knowledge.

item.title: Where Causal Discovery Breaks on Real Data: Measuring the Assumptions One Property at a Time
item.description: On real corporate-action data, tuned causal discovery underperforms simple cross-correlation within actions, and most direct pairs lack statistical power.

item.title: RiskReason: A Benchmark for Verifiable Financial Risk Reasoning
item.description: High financial-risk reasoning accuracy hides incorrect decisions, broken state propagation, and constraint violations that aggregate scores conceal.

item.title: Conformalized Execution Shields: Distribution-Free Finite-Sample Risk Guarantees and Maximum Favorable Excursion Bounds in Derivatives Markets
item.description: A conformalized execution shield vetoes low-expectancy derivative signals and guarantees 90.13 percent finite-sample MFE coverage.

item.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
item.description: Even leading AI agents cannot convert broad equity-research competence into accurate financial forecasts.

item.title: Decorrelating the Advice Layer: A Calibrated Fragility Metric and Tested Mitigations for Synchronized Liquidation in Agentic Wealth Management
item.description: Tail liquidation in agentic wealth management rises with synchronized automation not model concentration.

item.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
item.description: Cross-case procedural learning raises disclosure review requirement fulfillment without updating model weights.

item.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
item.description: Most LLM earnings forecast intervals miss actual EPS because forecasts run low.

item.title: TreasuryQA Bench: Can AI Agents Work an Archive of Scanned Financial Records?
item.description: Even top agents solve under two thirds of scanned archive questions and fail mainly on digit misreads.

item.title: Errors With No Common Sign: Certified Evaluation of Quantum and LLM Components in Financial Pipelines
item.description: Mechanical classical certification overturned financial quantum ML results in both directions and shows no quantum advantage.

item.title: LiveSearch: Questions as Executable Verifier Code for a Live Benchmark of Professional-Source Financial Search Agents
item.description: Reused financial-search snapshots fail most questions within one day as gold values change daily.

item.title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
item.description: Self-distillation gains come from supervision placement, not hint content or teacher size.

item.title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
item.description: Knowledge-graph-augmented LLMs beat state-of-the-art financial sentiment baselines in portfolio simulations at near-zero cost.

item.title: Does Ecosystem Activity Validate TVL?
item.description: Ecosystem-activity ratios do not make total value locked predict crypto returns after multiple-testing correction.

item.title: Event definition and the branching ratio: Hawkes estimates of price-change clustering in the consolidated quote feed
item.description: The sub-millisecond Hawkes kernel in large-tick stocks reflects NBBO feed construction, not genuine price-change excitation.

item.title: FIDES-Live: Evaluating Behavioral Concordance in Sequential Trading Agents
item.description: Commitment adherence drops to 62.63 percent for constrained nonempty proposals versus 97.56 percent for valid empty proposals.

item.title: Proof Before Price: Pre-Registered Behavioral Tests of Proof-Based Pricing on Language-Model Buying Agents
item.description: A register-verified claim boosts LLM buyer selection by 14 to 30 percentage points over identical prose.

item.title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
item.description: Right-number-wrong-account errors comprise 67.5 to 81.8 percent of failing financial analyst agent claims.

item.title: Risk-proportional inference: Constraint-aware model routing for fair and energy-efficient financial AI serving
item.description: RAIRoute cuts per-request inference energy by up to 70.9 percent while holding a fairness band.

item.title: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
item.description: Pre-reply claim checklists nearly eliminate false reversals under mistaken user pushback.

item.title: Do Round Numbers Hold Prices? Occupation Densities and Depth-Conditioned Hazards in the Limit Order Book
item.description: Round price levels draw more liquidity but do not slow depth-adjusted departures.

item.title: LLM-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Learning with Business Semantics for Financial Fraud Detection
item.description: SemHGT outperforms evaluated baselines on most dataset-metric comparisons across three fraud datasets.

item.title: What FLARE's Published Numbers Actually Measure
item.description: FLARE scores measure extraction-rule choice more than model quality because unspecified rules leave scores partially identified.

item.title: MBABench-2.0: Evaluating AI Agents on Constructing Financial Spreadsheets Beyond Simple Verifiability
item.description: Frontier agents cannot yet build spreadsheets that are both accurate and maintainable, with top pass rate at 16%.

item.title: Optimal Size in Market Making under State-Dependent Hawkes Process
item.description: State-dependent Hawkes calibrated quoting achieves higher terminal utility than a baseline while respecting inventory bounds.

item.title: Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds: A Reality Check
item.description: Cross-bond neural networks fail to outperform the random walk for next-day convertible bond price forecasting.

item.title: Towards Adversarially Robust Multigraph Neural Networks for Financial Crime Analysis
item.description: Learned structural attacks reduce multigraph neural network AML detection, while adversarial training improves defense against them.

item.title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
item.description: Governed agentic orchestration increases enterprise capacity without compromising control, cutting pricing effort by 38%.

item.title: Firms That Look Alike: Characteristic Graphs and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
item.description: In 2010–2024 U.S. stocks, graph neural networks on characteristic-based neighbours do not consistently beat a plain neural network using the same characteristics.

item.title: Opening the Black Box: Which News Explain LLM-Based Stock Ratings?
item.description: In S&P 500 news summaries, topics explain LLM stock ratings beyond sentiment, lifting within-R² from 7.17% to 15.17%.

item.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Financial Question Answering: Evidence from the FinQA Benchmark
item.description: Retrieval augmentation lifted a 4-billion-parameter financial QA model from 17.2% to 64.4% exact match, matching parameter-efficient fine-tuning at 63.9%.

item.title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
item.description: A protected invariant core cut a 24.6% sector drawdown to 0.3% and lowered maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies.

item.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
item.description: Filtering old news yielded 18.43% annual net returns for LLM portfolios with four-week delays, beating all news-using RL strategies.

item.title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
item.description: One passive execution raised intraday P&L by 1.28 currency units versus none, exceeding the 1.19-unit gain from a one-standard-deviation forecasting increase.

item.title: Headline Emphasis and Stock Returns: Evidence from Counterfactual Headlines
item.description: A one-standard-deviation rise in headline divergence predicts nine basis points higher next-month returns through initial overreaction and later correction.

item.title: The Common Advice: Evidence on AI Redundancy in Stock Prices
item.description: After ChatGPT, common AI signals still forecast positive earnings announcement returns, indicating market underreaction rather than AI-driven overreaction.

item.title: CrashGym: Measuring the Decision Value of Experimentation for LLM Agents in Counterfactual Market Crashes
item.description: Laboratory access cuts Luna's mean market-crash decision regret by 57.4 percent versus observe-only deployment.

item.title: VQuant: An Agentic Large Language Model Architecture for Automated Quantitative Financial Analysis and Document Generation: Reasoning-Augmented Tool Orchestration, In-Loop Numerical Computation, and Multi-Format Reporting
item.description: VQuant reports no empirical measurements of accuracy hallucination latency or cost for its agentic finance platform.

item.title: Sealed Before the Open: A Verifiable Standard for Measuring AI Forecasts of Financial Markets
item.description: Eleven large language models sealed market forecasts into a Bitcoin-anchored hash chain before the New York open.

item.title: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
item.description: An 8.2-million-parameter Mamba model decodes LOB order-flow imbalance at R²≈0.59 on unseen equities.

item.title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
item.description: Prediction-market launch features predict log-volume at out-of-sample R squared 0.747 but fail temporal generalization to later listing formats.

item.title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
item.description: Autoregressive LOB generators trained only on next-token prediction show emergent market impact with exponents 0.63 to 1.21, though none decays during relaxation.

item.title: Testing semi-strong market efficiency in Brazilian football: A risk-adjusted machine learning approach
item.description: Seven machine learning forecasters lose to Brazilian football's closing line on log loss, and half-Kelly staking destroys most capital at zero edge.

item.title: Candlestick Words Improve Intraday Volatility Forecasts Beyond HAR and GARCH
item.description: Candlestick-word features improve 15-minute volatility forecasts beyond HAR and GARCH after volatility spikes, but add nothing at daily frequency.

item.title: From SEC Filings to Financial Signals: Evaluating LLMs on Stock Market Reactions and Analyst Forecasts
item.description: Adding cross-sectional fundamental ranks to 10-Q MD&A text raises LLM return-ranking RankIC by about 0.009, while analyst-summary context adds no comparable gain.

item.title: Unbounded Losses, Unchecked Inputs: Measuring the Safeguards of LLM Options-Trading Agents
item.description: Options-trading agents need loss limits enforced at the order boundary, since 13 of 26 surveyed systems can reach unbounded loss.

item.title: More Mentions, Less Information? Diagnosing Identity and Alignment in Reddit Embeddings for Volatility Forecasting
item.description: Most of WSB embeddings' standalone volatility fit reflects firm identity, and their gain over HAR is largely eliminated by alignment shuffling.

item.title: Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents
item.description: QuantHarness reaches 90.72% task success on FinRelBench versus 74.23–84.54% for comparison systems, under the evaluated protocol.

item.title: Beyond Behavioral Accuracy: Evaluating Individual-Level Fidelity in LLM Investor Simulation
item.description: No evaluated LLM reliably beats a recent-activity persistence baseline for trade occurrence, and buy-sell structure stays hard to reproduce.

item.title: Combinatorial Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
item.description: Logical arbitrage across Polymarket contracts survived spreads and fees, yielding 2.2% guaranteed profit on settled portfolios in full-depth order-book replays.

item.title: Faithful by Construction? An Exact Test of LLM Explanations for Constrained Portfolio Optimization Decisions
item.description: LLM explanations of linear-program portfolio decisions name zero-effect limits as drivers in 77-89% of cases, so they need solver-certificate checks.

item.title: Which Outcome Should Teach an LLM Reader? A Verified FOMC Benchmark and Reward-Design Evidence for Outcome-Guided Agents in Finance
item.description: Pre-meeting equity returns are learnable from FOMC minutes at out-of-sample R² 0.50, while the next policy-rate change shows no detectable text signal.

item.title: Where Backtests and Live Trading Part Ways: Six Defects from One Intraday System
item.description: In one intraday US equity system, every backtest-live drift traced to two paths that should agree but had drifted apart.

item.title: What does a Rejection Mean? A Retrospective Audit of a Registered Trading-rule Archive
item.description: Of 23 nominal exclusions among 210 rejected rules, 22 survive a training-series re-verification, yet all carry secondary stopping failures.

item.title: When Judges Agree and Are Wrong: Consistency-Accuracy Dissociation as a Blind Spot for Label-Free Evaluation
item.description: On four financial QA datasets, 60% of wrong answers sit in high-consistency regions, so agreement-based label-free evaluation misses confident errors.

item.title: How Much Screening Buys a Second? Speed, Selection, and the Maker's Spread
item.description: A twelve-second maker must screen at least 84.5% of informed flow to match a one-second venue, versus 71.1% under a Gaussian model.

item.title: When Does "Post-Call" Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks
item.description: Moving from call-start to completion proxy flips return signs for 9.4% of 552 earnings calls, so labels depend on the declared outcome clock.

item.title: Trading Costs and Machine-Learning Return Forecasts
item.description: In U.S. stocks at $500 million, trading costs matter in portfolio construction, not the loss: spread-gated liquidity weighting lifts net Sharpe from -0.38 to 0.42.

item.title: Reading the News Without Hindsight: NoLBERT Topics and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
item.description: Benchmarking news attention shocks against 63 trading days instead of 5 raises out-of-sample rank IC for every news reader tested.

item.title: The Marginal Yield of LLM-Guided Alpha Search: Search Effort, Information and Investment Value
item.description: In this setup, additional LLM factor proposals improve training scores but add no net return distinguishable from zero.

item.title: Expressed distress and portfolio risk in LLM investment advice
item.description: In this preregistered test, client distress cut LLM allocations above a tolerance-matched volatility reference from 12.2% to 2.8%.
